title: Confocal Imaging Power Settings Protocol
author: Marco Polin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bu73nzqn

steps.title: Prepare the sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the specimen according to your experimental requirements before any imaging.

steps.title: Set microscope parameters
steps.instruction: Using the prepared sample, configure the confocal microscope with the correct laser line and scanning settings for the intended experiment.

steps.title: Calibrate the power meter
steps.instruction: Ensure the power meter is calibrated, zeroed, and set to the wavelength that matches the microscope laser.

substeps.instruction: Zero the power meter before measurement.
Select the laser wavelength on the meter.

steps.title: Position the power meter
steps.instruction: Remove the sample and place the power meter onto the sample holder, or use a power‑meter‑embedded slide if available.

substeps.instruction: Remove the specimen from the stage.
Place the power‑meter probe on the holder or slide.

steps.title: Measure laser power
steps.instruction: Turn the laser on and record the power reading from the meter.

steps.title: Repeat measurement for average
steps.instruction: Repeat the power measurement a few times to obtain an average or approximate value at the specimen position.

steps.title: Observe laser safety
steps.instruction: Do not look into the light path while holding the power meter; follow standard laser safety precautions.

steps.title: Record power and run experiment
steps.instruction: Record the measured laser power value and proceed with the imaging experiment.

steps.title: Post‑experiment power check
steps.instruction: At the end of the experiment, repeat the power measurement 3 to 8 times and record the final laser power.
